title: CC Bridge
description: Peer-messaging bridge between this DSH session and live Claude Code sessions (SendMessage wire protocol).
detail: Talks Claude Code's internal cross-session messaging protocol natively: registers as a first-class peer named 'dsh-bridge' in ~/.claude/sessions, so any Claude Code session can SendMessage it by name, and it can inject messages into any live CC session (idle sessions are woken). Tools: cc_who, cc_send, cc_recv, cc_status. Requires `npm i -g cc-bridge` and Claude Code 2.1.327+.
